test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 1 (Held On: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

The manager / took him / at task / for his negligence.
solution:
The correct answer is **'at task'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The erroneous part is at task.
 
• In the given sentence, **took him at task** is an incorrect phrase. 
 
• The correct phrase is **took him to task **which means to reprimand or criticize someone severely for a fault or mistake.
 
• So, using **at **is incorrect making the erroneous part **at task.**
 
• Thus, the sentence can be corrected by using **to **instead of **at.**

​***Correct sentence - ****The manager / took him / **to task** / for his negligence.*
